headline: IMF Projects 5.9% GDP Growth for Tanzania in 2026/27, Calls for Monetary Tightening and Faster Business Reforms and
summary: The IMF projects Tanzania's economy to grow 5.9% in 2026/27 after its 2026 Article IV mission. It calls for business and tax reforms and gradual monetary tightening amid external risks.
why: IMF Article IV assessments guide investor views on a country's growth outlook, policy direction and macroeconomic risks.
